summary: Add explicit-confirmation sequential execution for pending Reference evaluation questions with stop-after-current, unresolved-call preflight and resumable saved progress.
decision_refs: Active goal: CRIP reduces human work while managing advanced-model execution locally
Reuse the existing one-item endpoint and durable model-call safety instead of creating a second queue
Never parallelize, auto-retry or auto-resume evaluation dispatch
approval_evidence: The user defined CRIP as a labor-saving standalone local management platform and approved continued implementation of the advanced-model reference workflow.
known_limitations: Sequential dispatch is owned by the open browser tab; closing or refreshing stops after any in-flight request and requires a new explicit confirmation to resume.
The controller does not score engineering correctness or choose a preferred model result.
No live provider or fixed 15-question benchmark is run by offline implementation tests.
